title: [Model fails to open] whisper_init_from_file_with_params_no_state
body:
Hello, everyone,

I incorporated whisper.cpp as a backend into my SoftWhisper frontend. Some Windows users report that whisper-cli fails to open a model even though the file exists, printing:

whisper_init_from_file_with_params_no_state: loading model from 'models/ggml-base.en.bin'
whisper_init_from_file_with_params_no_state: failed to open 'models/ggml-base.en.bin'
error: failed to initialize whisper context

One user reports the problem when calling whisper-cli directly, so I suspect it is in whisper-cli rather than my graphical interface. I have not changed the whisper.cpp source apart from building it with Vulkan support. I cannot initially reproduce it because whisper-cli works for me even if I move folders around.

symptoms_visible: Some users see whisper-cli try to load 'models/ggml-base.en.bin', report that it failed to open the file, and fail to initialize the context even though they say the model file exists.
I initially cannot reproduce the behavior on my own machine, including after changing folders.
N0.label: N0 reported model-open failure

symptoms_visible: The affected reports I can identify are from Windows users; I cannot check Linux.
N1.label: N1 platform established

symptoms_visible: A CUDA-specific build does not change the reported behavior.
N1_x.label: N1_x CUDA rebuild aftermath

symptoms_visible: The experimental build with changed Windows path conversion does not materially change the problem.
N2_x.label: N2_x Windows path patch aftermath

symptoms_visible: When I reproduce the no-output problem with an explicit model and audio file, the model loads and language detection runs, then whisper-cli prints 'too many decoders requested (10), max = 8' and 'failed to process audio'.
N3.label: N3 actual processing failure captured

symptoms_visible: With beam size set to 8, whisper-cli processes the audio and prints a timestamped transcript on my computer.
The decoder-limit handling change also works on my computer; I have verified the console behavior, not the graphical interface.
N_terminal.label: terminal CLI output restored

question_patterns: Does this happen only on Windows, or are there affected users on other operating systems too?
Which operating systems are represented in the reports you have received?
clarifications.user_answer_in_this_oncall: I only use Windows, so I cannot check Linux. The other affected users also appear to be using Windows based on their screenshots.

counterfactual_candidates.answer: I can reproduce the same behavior on both Windows and Linux with the same command and files.
All reports I have are still from Windows, but they cover several Windows versions.

edges.comment: Issue comments c0-c1, describing the reporter and the Windows users whose reports were linked from the opening issue. The affected users are folded into the simulated user side without importing a Linux setup.

solution.intent: Rebuild whisper.cpp with CUDA instead of Vulkan in case the selected GPU backend is responsible for the failure.
solution.concrete_example: Build a CUDA-specific whisper-cli and try the same model and invocation instead of using the Vulkan build.

edges.comment: Reporter comment c2: the reporter compiled and tested a CUDA-specific version, but it did not change the issue. This is the reporter's Windows system and not a separate participant's deployment.

solution.intent: Replace the deprecated Windows UTF-8 path conversion with MultiByteToWideChar and stricter conversion error checks, treating model-path conversion as the cause.
solution.concrete_example: Build the experimental Windows version that converts paths with MultiByteToWideChar, reports conversion failures explicitly, and leaves non-Windows code unchanged.

edges.comment: Reporter comments c5 and c12-c13: a Windows path-conversion change was proposed and placed in an experimental build, but the reporter later said the patch did not fix much. The later accepted decoder diagnosis supersedes this path hypothesis.

question_patterns: Can you paste the exact whisper-cli command and all output from a run where no transcript appears?
What is the complete command line for a failing direct CLI run, and what are the last messages printed?
clarifications.user_answer_in_this_oncall: I can reproduce it directly with `whisper-cli.exe -m "D:\Work\Programming\Python\SoftWhisper\models\whisper\ggml-base.bin" -f "D:\Work\Translations\Transplus\03-18-2025\Audio fragment -- 03m.wav" -l auto -bs 10`. It detects Spanish and then prints `whisper_full_with_state: too many decoders requested (10), max = 8` followed by `whisper-cli.exe: failed to process audio`.

counterfactual_candidates.answer: The explicit-model command stops at the original failed-to-open message and never reaches language detection or audio processing.
The same command reports 12 requested decoders rather than 10, while still saying the maximum is 8.
The input audio has a different filename but the same command options and decoder-limit output.

edges.comment: Reporter comment c13: this is the reporter's own newly reproduced Windows CLI run. The answer preserves the raw command and error output; concluding that model opening succeeded and the decoder count is causal belongs to the final solution.

solution.intent: Treat the reproduced no-output failure as an excessive beam-size request, not a model-path or temporary-file failure: use no more than the compiled maximum of eight decoders and make the CLI reject or cap oversized requests with a clear warning.
solution.concrete_example: Run the same command with `-bs 8` or lower. In the frontend or CLI validation, prevent a beam size above `WHISPER_MAX_DECODERS`; either reject it clearly or fall back to the supported maximum with a warning. The reporter confirmed that `-bs 8` produces a transcript and later reported that the decoder-limit patch worked on the same computer.
solution.inference_hint: The reporter supplied a command containing `-bs 10` and raw output stating `too many decoders requested (10), max = 8`. The maintainer inferred that this decoder-limit violation, rather than path handling, caused the reproduced no-output failure. Separately, the maintainer observed that the opening failed-to-open-default-model text can be produced by invoking whisper-cli without an explicit model; that interpretation was not supplied by the reporter.

edges.comment: Participant1 c14 identified the `-bs 10` request as exceeding the compiled maximum of 8. Reporter c15 reran with beam size 8 and pasted successful transcript output; c17-c18 report that the proposed decoder-handling change fixed the bug on the reporter's computer. The subsequent AVX512 and GGML_NATIVE discussion concerns a separate binary-portability/build-configuration problem and is intentionally not spliced into this diagnostic chain.

satisfaction_conditions: Must identify the accepted cause of the reproduced no-output failure: the command requested 10 beam decoders while the compiled maximum was 8, so audio processing stopped after model loading and language detection.

Must ground the diagnosis in the collected command and raw error output, especially `-bs 10` and `too many decoders requested (10), max = 8`, rather than inferring a model-path failure from the opening line alone.
Must recommend using a beam size of 8 or lower and, for a code-level improvement, validating oversized requests by rejecting them clearly or capping them at the supported maximum with a warning.
Must not present switching from Vulkan to CUDA or modernizing Windows path conversion as the confirmed fix; both directions were tried without materially resolving the reproduced problem.

Must ask the user to verify that the same audio is processed and transcript output appears before declaring resolution; the reporter's successful `-bs 8` console run satisfies this verification, while the UI remained untested.

persona_hint.experience_level: Technically capable Windows application developer integrating whisper.cpp into a frontend; comfortable building Vulkan and CUDA variants, editing CMake-related code, creating experimental patches, and pasting complete CLI output.
persona_hint.communication_style: Cooperative, exploratory, and persistent; proposes hypotheses and patches, supplies exact commands and logs when the problem becomes reproducible, and openly corrects earlier assumptions.
